name: maxcut_16_3reg
title: MaxCut on a random 3-regular graph with 16 nodes
description: Partition the nodes into two sets so that as many edges as possible cross the partition. Graph: networkx random_regular_graph(3, 16, seed=7), connected, 24 edges; brute-force max cut 21.
goal: Find a high-quality cut and estimate how well a noisy QPU reproduces it.

checks.ideal_ratio_source: 3-regular graphs: p=1 guarantees 0.6924 (Farhi, Goldstone, Gutmann 2014); p=2 guarantees 0.7559 without short cycles (Wurtz & Love, PRA 103, 042612, 2021); deeper plans use the p=2 value (deeper optimal QAOA is never worse)
